_comment: SHAPE REFERENCE ONLY — the real file is beaches.local.json, which is gitignored and pushed to KV with push-beaches.sh. This example carries no local knowledge; every wind arc here is a placeholder.
_authoredBy: the owners — these arcs are not derivable from any public source

windNames._comment: Local names → degrees the wind blows FROM. Sisay never sees degrees; she sees verdicts.

beaches.name: Praia Example

wind._comment: Arcs are [fromDeg, toDeg] of the direction the wind BLOWS FROM. Arcs may wrap past 360. Anything not listed is treated as 'unknown' and Sisay will say so rather than guess.

swell._comment: Optional. Omit entirely for beaches nobody surfs.

beaches._comment: Some beaches behave differently end to end — Silveira's canto sul is offshore on a south wind while its canto norte is the shelter on a nordestão. Where that is true, give the beach `sections`; each section carries its own wind arcs and overrides the beach-level ones. Omit `sections` for beaches that behave as one.

sections.name: Canto Sul
sections.notes: What makes this end different from the rest of the beach.
